mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_REVIEW (TITLE, CONTENTS, T_COURSE_ID) VALUES (#{title}, #{contents}, #{courseId})
INSERT INTO T_REVIEW_IMAGE (URL_PATH, S_URL_PATH, T_REVIEW_ID) VALUES (#{urlPath}, #{sUrlPath}, #{reviewId})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS reviewId, r.title, r.contents, r.reg_date AS regDate, i.urlPath AS urlPath, i.sUrlPath AS sUrlPath, NVL(like_counts.like_count, 0) AS likeCount FROM T_REVIEW r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.t_review_id, i.url_path AS urlPath, i.s_url_path AS sUrlPath, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.t_review_id ORDER BY i.id) AS rn FROM T_REVIEW_IMAGE i ) i ON r.id = i.t_review_id AND i.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.t_review_id, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM T_SHARE s GROUP BY s.t_review_id ) like_counts ON r.id = like_counts.t_review_id

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.contents, r.reg_date AS regDate, i.id AS imageId, i.url_path AS urlPath, i.s_url_path AS sUrlPath FROM T_REVIEW r LEFT JOIN T_REVIEW_IMAGE i ON r.id = i.t_review_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
-- 특정 사용자가 좋아요한 리뷰를 조회하는 쿼리 예제 SELECT r.id AS id, r.title AS title, r.reg_date as regDate FROM t_share s JOIN t_review r ON s.t_review_id = r.id WHERE s.t_user_email = #{userEmail}
